usage: ‘布’ is a noun referring to 'cloth' or fabric material.
It can refer to any kind of textile used for making clothes or other items.
‘布’ often appears in compound words related to textiles, like 布料 (fabric).
You can use ‘布’ to talk about the material itself or describe something made from cloth.
